commands.name: 🎵第一步：TG音乐转存初始化(必须)
commands.description: 创建 /boot/tgautodown/目录并克隆项目并编译二进制文件，给予可执行权限，为后续运行做准备！
commands.command: export http_proxy={proxy_addr} https_proxy={proxy_addr}; mkdir -p /boot/tgautodown/ && cd /boot/tgautodown/; if command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'git already installed'; else apt -o Acquire::http::Proxy={proxy_addr} -o Acquire::https::Proxy={proxy_addr} update && apt -o Acquire::http::Proxy={proxy_addr} -o Acquire::https::Proxy={proxy_addr} install -y git; fi; REQUIRED_GO_VERSION=1.23.4; if command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1; then CURRENT_GO_VERSION=$(go version | awk '{print $3}' | sed 's/go//'); if dpkg --compare-versions "$CURRENT_GO_VERSION" ge "$REQUIRED_GO_VERSION"; then echo 'go version OK'; else echo 'go version too old, installing new'; apt remove -y golang-go golang-1.22 golang-src golang-doc 2>/dev/null || true; INSTALL_GO=true; fi; else echo 'go not installed'; INSTALL_GO=true; fi; if [ "$INSTALL_GO" = true ]; then ARCH=$(uname -m); case $ARCH in x86_64) GOARCH=amd64;; aarch64) GOARCH=arm64;; armv7l|armv8l) GOARCH=armv6l;; *) echo 'Unsupported arch'; exit 1;; esac; GO_VERSION=1.23.4; URL=https://go.dev/dl/go${GO_VERSION}.linux-${GOARCH}.tar.gz; if command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then wget -O /tmp/go.tar.gz "$URL"; elif command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -L "$URL" -o /tmp/go.tar.gz; else echo 'Need wget or curl'; exit 1; fi; rm -rf /usr/local/go; tar -C /usr/local -xzf /tmp/go.tar.gz; export PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH; fi; rm -rf tgautodown && git clone https://github.com/nasbump/tgautodown.git && cd tgautodown && export CGO_ENABLED=0 && export GOPROXY=https://goproxy.cn,direct && go build -o tgautodown . && chmod +x tgautodown

commands.name: 📥第一步：下载安装(必须)
commands.description: 下载 Ting Reader 后端(arm64)+前端到 /boot/ting-reader/ 并解压，生成 config.toml（端口3001），幂等：已存在则跳过下载
commands.command:
export V=1.5.9; mkdir -p /boot/ting-reader/ {tingreader_dir}/data {tingreader_dir}/temp {tingreader_dir}/storage; cd /boot/ting-reader/; if [ ! -f ting-reader ]; then curl -fL --retry 3 -o backend.tar.gz https://gh-proxy.org/https://github.com/dqsq2e2/ting-reader/releases/download/v${V}/ting-reader-backend-linux-arm64-${V}.tar.gz && curl -fL --retry 3 -o frontend.tar.gz https://gh-proxy.org/https://github.com/dqsq2e2/ting-reader/releases/download/v${V}/ting-reader-frontend-${V}.tar.gz && tar -xzf backend.tar.gz && tar -xzf frontend.tar.gz && chmod +x ting-reader && rm -f backend.tar.gz frontend.tar.gz; fi; mkdir -p plugins preinstalled-plugins logs; if [ -d preinstalled-plugins ]; then cp -a preinstalled-plugins/. /boot/ting-reader/preinstalled-plugins/ 2>/dev/null || true; fi; cat > config.toml <<'CFG'
version = "1.5.9"

[server]
host = "0.0.0.0"
port = {port}
max_connections = 100
request_timeout = 30

[database]
path = "{tingreader_dir}/data/ting-reader.db"
connection_pool_size = 10
busy_timeout = 30000

[plugins]
plugin_dir = "/boot/ting-reader/plugins"
preinstalled_dir = "/boot/ting-reader/preinstalled-plugins"
enable_hot_reload = true
max_memory_per_plugin = 536870912
max_execution_time = 300

[task_queue]
max_concurrent_tasks = 10
default_retry_count = 3
task_timeout = 600

[logging]
level = "info"
format = "json"
output = "stdout"
log_file = "/boot/ting-reader/logs/ting-reader.log"
max_file_size = 10485760
max_backups = 5

[security]
enable_auth = false
api_key = ""
allowed_origins = ["*"]
rate_limit_requests = 100
rate_limit_window = 60
enable_hsts = false
hsts_max_age = 31536000

[storage]
data_dir = "{tingreader_dir}/data"
temp_dir = "{tingreader_dir}/temp"
local_storage_root = "{tingreader_dir}/storage"
local_library_roots = []
max_disk_usage = 2147483648

[audio]
cache_enabled = true
cache_size = 104857600
buffer_size = 65536

commands.name: 第一步：下载安装 cfst (必须)
commands.description: 下载 CloudflareSpeedTest arm64 版到手机并生成转换推送脚本
commands.command:
set -e
mkdir -p /boot/cf-speedtest && cd /boot/cf-speedtest
echo "[1/3] 下载 cfst arm64..."
curl -L --connect-timeout 15 -o cfst.tar.gz "https://github.com/XIU2/CloudflareSpeedTest/releases/download/v2.3.5/cfst_linux_arm64.tar.gz" || curl -x {proxy} -L --connect-timeout 15 -o cfst.tar.gz "https://github.com/XIU2/CloudflareSpeedTest/releases/download/v2.3.5/cfst_linux_arm64.tar.gz"
tar xzf cfst.tar.gz
echo "[2/3] 拷贝需要的文件..."
cp -f "$(find . -maxdepth 2 -name cfst -type f | head -1)" cfst

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""CloudflareSpeedTest 结果转换 + GitHub 推送 (手机版)
读取 result.csv -> 生成 "IP:443#地区-延迟ms-速度MB/s" -> 推送到 GitHub 仓库
配置从环境变量读取：CF_REPO / CF_FILE / CF_COUNT / CF_TOKEN / CF_CSV / CF_OUT
"""
import csv, json, sys, os, base64, urllib.request

# ============ 配置（环境变量优先）============
REPO = os.environ.get("CF_REPO", "")
BRANCH = os.environ.get("CF_BRANCH", "main")
FILE_PATH = os.environ.get("CF_FILE", "")
IP_COUNT = int(os.environ.get("CF_COUNT", "50") or "50")
GITHUB_TOKEN = os.environ.get("CF_TOKEN", "")
RESULT_CSV = os.environ.get("CF_CSV", "result.csv")
OUTPUT_TXT = os.environ.get("CF_OUT", "1-px.txt")
CF_PROXY = os.environ.get("CF_PROXY", "")  # 可选代理，如 http://127.0.0.1:7890
# ============================================

COLO_MAP = {
    "SIN": "新加坡", "HKG": "香港", "NRT": "东京", "KIX": "大阪",
    "ICN": "首尔", "TPE": "台北", "LAX": "洛杉矶", "SJC": "圣何塞",
    "SFO": "旧金山", "SEA": "西雅图", "PDX": "波特兰", "ORD": "芝加哥",
    "DFW": "达拉斯", "ATL": "亚特兰大", "IAD": "华盛顿", "EWR": "纽瓦克",
    "JFK": "纽约", "BOS": "波士顿", "MIA": "迈阿密", "YYZ": "多伦多",
    "YVR": "温哥华", "MEX": "墨西哥城", "FRA": "法兰克福", "AMS": "阿姆斯特丹",
    "LHR": "伦敦", "CDG": "巴黎", "WAW": "华沙", "ARN": "斯德哥尔摩",
    "HEL": "赫尔辛基", "MAD": "马德里", "BCN": "巴塞罗那", "ZRH": "苏黎世",
    "MIL": "米兰", "FCO": "罗马", "VIE": "维也纳", "PRG": "布拉格",
    "IST": "伊斯坦布尔", "DME": "莫斯科", "DXB": "迪拜", "BOM": "孟买",
    "DEL": "德里", "SYD": "悉尼", "MEL": "墨尔本", "GRU": "圣保罗",
    "EZE": "布宜诺斯艾利斯", "JNB": "约翰内斯堡", "KBP": "基辅",
    "LIS": "里斯本", "CPH": "哥本哈根", "OSL": "奥斯陆", "DUB": "都柏林",
    "BRU": "布鲁塞尔", "HND": "东京", "CTS": "札幌", "FUK": "福冈",
    "OKA": "冲绳", "NGO": "名古屋", "DEN": "丹佛", "PHX": "凤凰城",
    "SAN": "圣迭戈", "LAS": "拉斯维加斯", "SLC": "盐湖城", "MSP": "明尼阿波利斯",
    "DTW": "底特律", "PHL": "费城", "CMH": "哥伦布", "RDU": "罗利",
    "AUS": "奥斯汀", "HOU": "休斯顿", "PIT": "匹兹堡", "MCI": "堪萨斯城",
    "STL": "圣路易斯", "BNA": "纳什维尔", "TPA": "坦帕", "MSY": "新奥尔良",
    "SDF": "路易斯维尔", "IND": "印第安纳波利斯", "CLE": "克利夫兰",
    "CVG": "辛辛那提", "BWI": "巴尔的摩", "CLT": "夏洛特", "ANC": "安克雷奇",
    "HNL": "檀香山", "KUL": "吉隆坡", "BKK": "曼谷", "CGK": "雅加达",
    "SGN": "胡志明", "HAN": "河内", "MNL": "马尼拉", "PER": "珀斯",
    "AKL": "奥克兰", "N/A": "未知", "": "未知",
}


def colo_to_cn(code):
    code = (code or "").strip()
    return COLO_MAP.get(code, code if code else "未知")


def parse_result(csv_path, limit=110):
    rows = []
    with open(csv_path, "r", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f)
        for r in reader:
            ip = (r.get("IP 地址") or "").strip()
            ping = (r.get("平均延迟") or "0").strip()
            speed = (r.get("下载速度(MB/s)") or "0").strip()
            colo = (r.get("地区码") or "").strip()
            loss = (r.get("丢包率") or "0").strip()
            if not ip:
                continue
            try:
                ping_f = float(ping)
            except ValueError:
                ping_f = 9999.0
            try:
                speed_f = float(speed)
            except ValueError:
                speed_f = 0.0
            # 关键: 过滤掉没有真实下载速度的 IP（速度为 0 = 未测过带宽），避免凑数
            if speed_f <= 0:
                continue
            rows.append((ip, ping_f, speed_f, colo, loss))
    rows.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[2], x[1]))
    return rows[:limit]


def generate_txt(rows):
    lines = []
    for ip, ping, speed, colo, loss in rows:
        cn = colo_to_cn(colo)
        ping_s = f"{ping:.0f}" if ping < 9999 else "9999"
        speed_s = f"{speed:.2f}" if speed > 0 else "0.00"
        lines.append(f"{ip}:443#{cn}-{ping_s}ms-{speed_s}MB/s")
    return "\n".join(lines) + ("\n" if lines else "")


def gh_api(method, url, token, body=None):
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
    req.add_header("Authorization", f"Bearer {token}")
    req.add_header("Accept", "application/vnd.github+json")
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    if CF_PROXY:
        proxy_handler = urllib.request.ProxyHandler({
            "https": CF_PROXY, "http": CF_PROXY,
        })
        opener = urllib.request.build_opener(proxy_handler)
    else:
        opener = urllib.request.build_opener()
    try:
        with opener.open(req, timeout=30) as resp:
            return resp.status, json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, json.loads(e.read().decode())


def push_to_github(content, token):
    base = f"https://api.github.com/repos/{REPO}/contents/{FILE_PATH}"
    status, data = gh_api("GET", f"{base}?ref={BRANCH}", token)
    sha = data.get("sha") if status == 200 else None
    if status != 200 and status != 404:
        print(f"[推送] GET 失败: {status} {data}")
        return False
    body = {
        "message": f"chore: 更新优选IP ({len(content.splitlines())}条)",
        "content": base64.b64encode(content.encode()).decode(),
        "branch": BRANCH,
    }
    if sha:
        body["sha"] = sha
    status, data = gh_api("PUT", base, token, body)
    if status in (200, 201):
        print(f"[推送] 成功! {status} -> {REPO}/{FILE_PATH}")
        return True
    print(f"[推送] 失败: {status} {data}")
    return False


def main():
    if not REPO or not FILE_PATH or not GITHUB_TOKEN:
        print("[错误] 未配置推送参数！请在 lab 面板 cfst 第二步的变量里填写：GitHub仓库、仓库内文件路径、GitHub Token")
        sys.exit(1)
    csv_path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else RESULT_CSV
    limit = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else IP_COUNT
    rows = parse_result(csv_path, limit)
    if not rows:
        print("[错误] 没有解析到任何结果")
        sys.exit(1)
    txt = generate_txt(rows)
    with open(OUTPUT_TXT, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(txt)
    print(f"[转换] 已生成 {len(rows)} 条 -> {OUTPUT_TXT}")
    print(f"[示例] 第一条: {rows[0][0]}:443#{colo_to_cn(rows[0][3])}-{rows[0][1]:.0f}ms-{rows[0][2]:.2f}MB/s")
    if "--push" in sys.argv:
        if push_to_github(txt, GITHUB_TOKEN):
            print("[完成] 推送成功")
        else:
            sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
PYEOF
